title: poa badensis subsp. molinerii
intro: Poa badensis subsp. molinerii, commonly known as Alpine meadow-grass, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the grass family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and inflammation, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Poa badensis subsp. molinerii include soothing the digestive system, reducing inflammation, and acting as an anti-spasmodic, which can help alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome and other gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
